description: Type Bigtable's 400 for a table that isn't ready: still being created, restored or deleted. Observed live 2026-10-27: deleting a table whose column-family change is still applying, and reading or reading the IAM policy of a table being restored by UndeleteTable, answer 400 '... is still being created' or '... is either creating or deleting, please try again'. It surfaced as an out-of-union BadRequest, so callers could not wait it out with a typed retry.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The table isn't ready: it is still being created, modified, restored or deleted (HTTP 400: '... is still being created' / '... is either creating or deleting'). The API doesn't say which. Retryable after a short wait.
